name: Shelly switch example
info:
A wall switch wired to a Shelly Gen2 relay in detached mode, where the relay is the room's main light: the switch's presses go through the switch policy to the room controller, and the room switches the relay through the same Shelly node, with no function nodes. The adapter reads the device's own configuration (its mode and input type) each time it connects and shows it in its status. Its Target, main, is the light's id in the room's Targets JSON, marked onOffOnly; the room's light commands reach it on its input, and its readings go back to the room on its third output.

Set the adapter's MQTT topic prefix to your device's (its device ID unless you set one). If the relay powers smart bulbs instead, leave the Target empty and wire the switch policy to the room that drives the bulbs.

Before deploying, open the "your MQTT broker" config node (any node's Broker setting) and set your broker's host: every node here that talks MQTT subscribes and publishes through it, with no MQTT in, MQTT out or status nodes.
